paragraphs.text: The old shoe factory stood empty for twelve years before the town bought it in 2015. The roof was replaced, but the brick walls and the iron columns were kept, and the machines were given to a museum.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The library opened in 2019 and now has 40,000 books. It also lends musical instruments, a service that no other library in the region offers. Opening hours were extended to nine in the evening after a survey of readers.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: The factory was bought by a private company.
The original walls were removed during the rebuilding.
The library is the only one in the region that lends instruments.
Most readers asked for longer opening hours.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
